text: dsh-loop-detector 是面向 DSH agent 的重复输出检测插件。它监听 agent 的文本与思考流，也检查工具调用参数是否反复围绕同一主题。插件用周期、n-gram 和大段锚点识别文本重复，并用关键词新颖度与相似度发现换措辞的重复调用；命中后可中断生成、引导重试，达到次数上限后停止。适合希望减少 agent 卡在重复回答或重复搜索的 DSH 用户。无需 API 密钥，需在 DSH profile 中启用。

dsh-loop-detector detects repeated DSH agent output with period, n-gram, and anchor checks, and repeated tool intent by comparing recent argument keywords. It can interrupt a loop, guide a retry, then stop after the retry limit. No API key is needed; enable it in a DSH profile.
DSH agent 一直重复同一段话时，能自动停下来吗？
想检测模型输出里的周期性复读并打断生成。
让 DSH 发现思考内容反复出现时也能停止。
搜索工具换着说法重复查同一个主题，怎么让 agent 察觉？
希望重复搜索达到次数后给模型一次重试机会，再停掉循环。
能不能只监控指定的工具调用，识别参数内容反复但措辞不同？
markdown 分隔线很多时，怎样避免把格式重复误判成死循环？
我想限制重复检测的缓冲长度，并调整命中后的冷却时间。
How can I stop an agent that keeps repeating the same answer?
Can DSH detect reworded searches that keep targeting the same topic?
dsh-loop-detector 的功能「流式文本复读检测」：监听 agent 输出的正文和可选思考分片，以周期、重复 n-gram 或重现的大段文本识别循环；命中后可中断生成并给出引导。
dsh-loop-detector 的功能「重复工具意图检测」：对匹配工具的参数提取关键词，与近期调用主题比较新颖度和相似度；连续停滞达到阈值时识别为重复意图并触发中断处理。
dsh-loop-detector 的功能「中断与引导重试」：检测命中后先取消当前生成，再投递指导消息；重试次数耗尽或选择直接取消时停止 agent。

dsh-loop-detector README · dsh-loop-detector：Local LLMs (especially quantized / RL-tuned reasoning models) sometimes get stuck:
repeating the same sentence forever, or re-running `web_search` with reworded queries
for the same topic without gaining any new information. This plugin watches the
agent's stream in real time, detects both kinds of loops, and **interrupts them
hard** — not a soft reminder the model can ignore.

> 中文文档见 [README.zh.md](README.zh.md).

dsh-loop-detector README · dsh-loop-detector：> **v2.0.0 targets dsh 0.2.x.** If you installed v1 on dsh 0.2.x and it never fired,
> that is expected — see the next section.

dsh-loop-detector README · Why v1 does not work on dsh 0.2.x：| Problem | v1 | Reality on 0.2.x | v2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Never sees streamed text | listened to `session/event` → `assistant/chunk` | `assistant/chunk` is no longer a live v2 session event (only the legacy-format migration packages read it) | listens to **`agent/assistant-stream`** |
| Interrupt does not interrupt | used `agent.steer()` as the interrupt | `steer()` only queues a message for the **next step**; it does not abort the current generation | `agent.cancel(cause, { keepInbox: true })` first, then `steer()` to guide |
| Retry budget never runs out | reset the counter on `turn/end` | every `steer()` opens a new turn, so the counter was cleared as soon as it grew | resets on **genuine user input** (plugin-injected messages are tracked by id and excluded) |
section: Why v1 does not work on dsh 0.2.x

text:
dsh-loop-detector README · Why v1 does not work on dsh 0.2.x：v1's intent detector also tokenized on "non-alphanumeric", which collapses a whole
Chinese sentence into a single token — so **Chinese reworded-search loops were never
detected**. v2 uses "stop-character splitting + CJK bigrams + Jaccard similarity".
section: Why v1 does not work on dsh 0.2.x

text:
dsh-loop-detector README · Features：- **Text-level repetition detection** — watches `agent/assistant-stream` for
  `text-delta` and (optionally) `reasoning-delta`, with three layered detectors:
  1. **Period scan**: the tail repeats with a fixed period (default 8–256 chars) ≥4 times
  2. **n-gram**: the same 64-char block appears ≥3 times inside the last 2048 chars
  3. **Large anchor**: the trailing 512 chars reappear earlier and extend backwards
     (catches "the whole plan printed twice")
- **Noise rejection**: a repeated unit needs ≥2 distinct characters and ≥30% substantive
  characters (letters/digits/CJK), so markdown rules (`--------`, `|:---|:---|`) are not
  mistaken for a loop.
- **Tool-call intent-level detection** — watches `tools/post-execute`, extracts keywords
  from each call's arguments, and compares them against the union of the last 3 calls.
  A low novelty ratio **or** a high Jaccard similarity, twice in a row, means
  "same task, reworded". `toolPatterns` takes wildcards, so `grep`, shell commands, etc.
  can participate.
- **Hard interrupt**: the current generation is actually aborted, then a guidance message
  is handed to the model for one retry; after `ma

dsh-loop-detector README · Features：dsh ships `@deepseek-ai/dsh-repeat-tool-reminder`, but it is **advisory only** (injected
as context). In practice local models (e.g. Qwen / Ornith 35B MoE with reasoning off)
ignore it and keep looping — which is exactly why this plugin exists.

dsh-loop-detector README · Option 1: link it as a local dependency：> **Dependency-resolution contract**: every runtime dependency of this plugin
> (`@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `dsh-agent`, `dsh-llm`, `dsh-tools`, `schemastery`) is declared in
> **`peerDependencies`**. For a `link:`-ed plugin, dsh's profile resolver routes a bare
> specifier to **dsh's own installed copy** only when the plugin's `package.json` lists that
> name under `peerDependencies`. Do not move these into `dependencies`: Node would then look
> inside the plugin's own `node_modules`, and a miss fails the whole plugin load.

dsh-loop-detector README · Interrupt behaviour：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `minLen` | `512` | Start detecting only after this many characters |
| `maxRetries` | `1` | Interrupt-and-guide attempts; then the turn is cancelled |
| `action` | `'steer'` | `'steer'` = interrupt + guided retry; `'cancel'` = cancel on first hit |
| `cooldownMs` | `1500` | Cooldown after a hit (residual chunks must not re-trigger) |
| `checkText` | `true` | Detect plain text output |
| `checkReasoning` | `true` | Detect reasoning output |
| `checkEvery` | `64` | Run the detector at most once per this many new characters |
| `bufferLimit` | `16384` | Trailing characters kept per stream (bounded memory) |

dsh-loop-detector README · Tool-call intent-level detection：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `toolPatterns` | `['web_search']` | Tools to watch (wildcards); empty array disables the feature |
| `historySize` | `3` | How many recent calls form the topic keyword set |
| `noveltyThreshold` | `0.25` | Novel-keyword ratio below this counts as "no new information" |
| `similarityThreshold` | `0.5` | Jaccard similarity at or above this counts as the same topic |
| `stallLimit` | `2` | Consecutive stalled calls before it is a loop |

dsh-loop-detector README · Detector tuning (rarely needed)：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `minPeriod` / `maxPeriod` | `8` / `256` | Period scan range |
| `periodRepeats` | `4` | How many identical periods make a loop |
| `ngramSize` / `ngramRepeats` | `64` / `3` | n-gram block size and minimum repeats |
| `ngramWindow` / `ngramStep` | `2048` / `16` | n-gram window and sampling stride |
| `anchorSize` / `anchorWindow` | `512` / `8192` | Anchor length and window |
| `minDistinctChars` | `2` | Minimum distinct characters in a repeated unit |
| `minSubstantiveRatio` | `0.3` | Minimum substantive-character ratio in a repeated unit |
| `legacySessionEvents` | `false` | Old-dsh compatibility channel (`session/event` → `assistant/chunk`) |

dsh-loop-detector README · Detector tuning (rarely needed)：Invalid configuration (unknown `action`, `minLen < 1`, ratios outside `[0,1]`) fails loudly
at mount time instead of silently falling back.

dsh-loop-detector README · How it works：Text level ([`src/detector.ts`](src/detector.ts)):

```
1) period scan  tail repeats a period of [minPeriod..maxPeriod] for periodRepeats times
2) n-gram       the same ngramSize-char block appears >= ngramRepeats times in ngramWindow
3) anchor       trailing anchorSize chars reappear earlier and extend >= anchorSize back
every layer additionally requires a "meaningful" unit: >= minDistinctChars distinct chars

Tool-intent level ([`src/intent.ts`](src/intent.ts)):

dsh-loop-detector README · How it works：```
keywords   = latin words + CJK bigrams split on stop characters
topic      = union of the last historySize calls' keywords
novelty    = novel keywords / current keywords
similarity = |intersection| / |union|            (Jaccard)

CJK bigrams exist because whitespace tokenization is meaningless for Chinese; the extra
similarity criterion exists because rewording in Chinese naturally introduces new bigrams.

dsh-loop-detector README · Development and tests：```powershell
npm test    # node --test runs .ts natively (Node >= 22.18 type stripping)
```

39 tests cover all three detectors (hits and non-hits: markdown rules, ordinary prose,
short text), Chinese/English keyword extraction and intent decisions, configuration
validation, and — using a **real cordis Context and the real dsh-agent scoped dispatcher** —
the wiring of `agent/assistant-stream` / `agent/pre-step` / `tools/post-execute` plus the
"interrupt + guide, then cancel" behaviour.

dsh-loop-detector README · Development and tests：Running the tests requires `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent` and
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` to be resolvable. A bare `node --test` never goes through dsh's
profile resolver, so this repo may contain a git-ignored `node_modules` junction pointing at
dsh's installation `node_modules` — it exists **only for local tests**. At runtime dsh uses
its own resolver and does not depend on it.

dsh-loop-detector README · Development and tests：```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path .\node_modules `
  -Target "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\dsh\resources\app\dsh\node_modules"   # your dsh install dir
```

dsh-loop-detector README · Limitations：- Detection is heuristic; tune the thresholds for your model. For small local models try
  `minLen` between 256 and 512.
- Intent-level detection compares argument strings, not meaning. A very broad
  `toolPatterns` (e.g. `'*'`) may false-positive on legitimately varied tool use.
- Interrupts are in-process: counters restart from zero after a dsh restart or session resume.
- Subagents are counted independently (keyed per agent); parent and child loops are never merged.
